name: Chin Tuck
description: Gently pull your chin straight back to align your neck and relieve forward-head tension.

name: Neck Side Tilt
description: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder to release tension along the side of the neck.

name: Neck Rotation Stretch
description: Slowly rotate your head to look over each shoulder to improve cervical mobility.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
description: Pull one arm across your chest to stretch the rear deltoid and shoulder capsule.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
description: Place your forearm on a doorframe and lean through to open up tight shoulders and chest.

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
description: Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow to stretch the tricep and shoulder.

name: Thread the Needle
description: From all fours, thread one arm under your body to rotate and stretch the upper back.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: Alternate between arching and rounding your back to mobilize the thoracic spine.

name: Open Book Stretch
description: Lie on your side and rotate your top arm open like a book to stretch the upper back.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneel and fold forward with arms extended to gently decompress the lower back.

name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
description: Lie on your back and pull one knee toward your chest to release lower back tightness.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
description: Lie on your back and drop your knees to one side to decompress the lumbar spine.

name: Pigeon Pose
description: Bring one leg forward into a bent position to deeply stretch the hip flexors and glutes.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Kneel on one knee and push your hips forward to stretch the hip flexor.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: Sit with soles of feet together and press knees toward the floor to open the hips.

name: Standing Forward Fold
description: Hinge at the hips and reach toward your toes to stretch the entire hamstring chain.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
description: Sit with one leg extended and reach toward your toes for a deep hamstring stretch.

name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
description: Lie on your back and lift one straight leg toward the ceiling to stretch the hamstring.

name: Quad Stretch
description: Stand and pull one heel toward your glute to stretch the quad and relieve knee tension.

name: Gentle Knee Bend
description: Slowly bend and straighten your knees to promote blood flow and joint mobility.

name: IT Band Stretch
description: Cross one leg behind the other and lean away to stretch the IT band along the outer knee.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
description: Place your hands on a wall and step one foot back to deeply stretch the calf muscle.

name: Stair Calf Drop
description: Stand on a step edge and let your heels drop below for a deep calf and Achilles stretch.

name: Soleus Stretch
description: Bend your back knee slightly during a wall stretch to target the deeper soleus muscle.

name: Ankle Circles
description: Rotate your ankle in full circles to improve mobility and reduce stiffness.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
description: Kneel and press your knee forward over your toes to improve ankle dorsiflexion range.

name: Seated Toe Pull
description: Sit and gently pull your toes back toward your shin to stretch the top of the foot and ankle.

name: Sun Salutation Flow
description: A flowing yoga sequence that stretches every major muscle group from head to toe.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
description: A multi-step lunge stretch that opens hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, and shoulders.

name: Standing Side Bend
description: Reach overhead and lean to each side to lengthen the lateral chain from hip to fingertip.
